requests.note: Wade asks the front office to go after Andre Miller (Los Angeles Clippers, rookie contract ending June 30, 2003) to run the point next to him.

requests.subject: free_agent_target
requests.note: Wade asks the front office to pursue Lamar Odom (Los Angeles Clippers, restricted free agent). Under world rule 1 his real August 2003 move to Miami never happens; he stays a Clippers free agent unless simulated Miami signs him, through an offer sheet the Clippers may match.
